This '''lightsaber''' was created and wielded by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. While a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Mundi's blade was [[Color/Legends|purple]]. After achieving the rank of Master, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and until Mundi's death on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], the blade was blue.

==History==
[[File:KiAdiMundi-TCW.png|thumb|left|300px|Mundi wielding his lightsaber]]

During his [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticeship]] to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] wielded a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a ridged, cylindrical, gray [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]]. Mundi practiced [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] against [[Marksman-H combat remote]]s with the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]]<ref name="SW3" /> of his own construction,<ref name="PotJ" /> and following his ascension to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="SW5">[[Star Wars (1998) 5|''Star Wars'' (1998) 5]]</ref> after 21 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of training, carried it upon his return to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]<ref name="SW4" /> around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].<ref name="VowDate">According to ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'', the events of "[[Vow of Justice]]" take place approximately 35 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before those of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], 35 years after [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].</ref>

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], shortly before his appointment to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the blade of Mundi's saber had taken on a purple hue, though its hilt remained unchanged from its earlier iteration.<ref name="SW5" /> At this time, the lightsaber was seized from Ki-Adi-Mundi's person by [[Maj-Odo-Nomor]], a Cerean youth, who inadvertently [[Death/Legends|took a life]] with the weapon.<ref name="SW1">[[Star Wars (1998) 1|''Star Wars'' (1998) 1]]</ref> While Mundi investigated the crime, the Cerean [[Council of Elders (Cerea)|Council of Elders]] held his lightsaber as evidence.<ref name="SW2">[[Star Wars (1998) 2|''Star Wars'' (1998) 2]]</ref>

Ki-Adi-Mundi was trained as a [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardian]] and was considered one of the top ten swordsmen in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He used a one-handed style during combat which was possibly [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]]. During his duel with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], he used the [[Form IV/Legends|Ataru]] opening stance. Notably, Mundi was the last Jedi standing during the grueling duel with Grievous on Hypori despite being exhausted from the battle that preceded it and while facing a style of lightsaber combat never before encountered by the Order. Also Mundi's lightsaber was briefly taken by Grievous, forcing him to use one of the cyborg's green lightsabers on his belt, but Mundi managed to recover his lightsaber when help arrived.<ref name="CW20" /> Later, the Cerean proved his skills in a duel with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], whom he forced into retreat.<ref>''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref > Mundi continued to wield his blue-bladed lightsaber for the rest of the war until he was killed during the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] on Mygeeto.<ref name="EP3">{{Film|III}}</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While other issues of ''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]'' portray Mundi's lightsaber with a purple blade in their "present"-set sections, limiting its green-bladed appearance to the chronologically earlier "[[Vow of Justice]]" back-up story,<ref name="SW4" /> the series' [[Star Wars (1998) 3|third issue]] depicts the lightsaber with a green blade in both the present setting and flashbacks.<ref name="SW3" />
